crossRefs.note: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad…
But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to…
The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

people.name: Eber
people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
translations.bsb: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
translations.kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
translations.asv: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.
